question:
Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below.

Fret
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Relax'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Fret"** means to feel or express worry, annoyance, or discontent.
 
• It can also mean to agitate or worry someone.(चिंता करना)
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to **"Fret" **is option 3:** "Relax".**
 
• **To "Relax" means** to make or become less tense or anxious, or to rest from work or engage in an enjoyable activity so as to become less tired or anxious. (आराम करना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Relax'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Anxious" **means experiencing worry, unease, or nervousness, typically about an imminent event or something with an uncertain outcome.(चिंतित)
 
• **"Anguish"** means severe mental or physical pain or suffering. (यातना)
 
• **"Pine"** means to suffer a mental and physical decline, especially because of a broken heart. (तड़पना)
